sourceBaseline.source: Greenfield v1.8.5 release package (this delivery chain)

change.purpose: Operator report 2026-09-26 with diagnostics export (v1.8.5): the queue hangs after the TTL has run out; overlay 'TTL 0:00 -> köbyte till GF-051 · nästa Ctrl-F5 om 0:00 · Spärr: THINKING_MODE_UNVERIFIED'.
change.rootCause: tickWaiting returned through holdForSafety whenever the current model proof was not allowed, before maybeEscalateWaitingRefresh: after F5 30 the ladder (Ctrl-F5 60/90, 120 min queue switch/rotation) never ran. Export: GF-052 held 11 h 19 min (665 consecutive SAFETY_HOLD observations), GF-044 held 16 h (962), both WAITING and holding both capacity slots, so GF-046 waited in SENDING since 18:29. The hold began seconds after each F5 30: reloaded pages render ChatGPT's newer composer, where the thinking level is the model picker's text ('Extra hög Välj ChatGPT-modell', 'Direkt Välj ChatGPT-modell') and the former 'Djupgående' chip is gone; adapter v4 found no reasoning control (THINKING_MODE_UNVERIFIED). GF-052's conversation rendered no turns from ~19:03 (THREAD_MISSING) and the reload at 20:03:29 ended on the GPT root, so no answer could appear there.
change.fix: background.js tickWaiting: a model-proof hold runs maybeEscalateWaitingRefresh before holdForSafety (nothing is posted; SENDING remains gated; IN_FLIGHT_QUALITY_QUARANTINE unchanged). lib/safety-policy.js effort(): 'extra hög|extra high|extra-high|xhigh' rank 3, 'hög|high' rank 2 (after rank 3). lib/model-observation.js (adapter 5): a model-switcher control whose text ranks as an effort is the selected-effort control when no composer chip or structural reasoning control exists (MODEL_SWITCHER_SELECTED_EFFORT); a picker inside the composer is already found by the composer scan. 'Direkt' stays THINKING_MODE_UNVERIFIED (not MODEL_DEGRADED, so no sticky in-flight quarantine).
change.runtimeChange: stale-session ladder continues under a model-proof hold; new picker levels accepted as effort evidence
